headline: 34 contracts catalogued across Ethereum and World Chain; 10 governance/admin multisigs and 24 protocol contracts

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'World Chain' on Ethereum mainnet surfaced 8 core infrastructure contracts: L1StandardBridge (0x470458c9...), OptimismPortal2 (0xd5ec14a8...), L1CrossDomainMessenger (0xf931a81d...), SystemConfig (0x6ab0777f...), DisputeGameFactory (0x069c4c57...), L1OpUSDCBridgeAdapter (0x153a69e4...), SuperchainConfig (0x95703e09...), and multiple ProxyAdmin/multisig addresses.

Official deployments doc at docs.world.org/world-chain/reference/useful-contracts lists 30+ deployed addresses across Tokens (WLD, WBTC, SDAI, WETH, USDC), World ID contracts, Gnosis Safe modules, Uniswap contracts, Grants contracts, MiniKit, Account Abstraction, and Oracles on World Chain Mainnet.
No audit links were recorded in the pinned protocol context; discovery of audit PDFs was not completed in this run.
GitHub repository not pinned in protocol context (null value); D4 GitHub artifact discovery skipped.

Only Ethereum chain is pinned in protocol.chains; World Chain (L2) is a separate deployment but not listed as a discovery target chain. Addresses sourced from docs are noted but chainId attribute confirmed as Ethereum (1) for L1 bridge infrastructure.
No factory-pattern child enumeration required; core infrastructure contracts (bridge, portal, messenger) are non-factory singletons per OP Stack standard.

Role taxonomy applied: 'proxy_admin' (ProxyAdmin 0xd7405be7...), 'admin' (Alchemy Multisig 1 0xa4fb12d1..., OpFoundationUpgradeSafe 0x847b5c17...), 'guardian' (Optimism Security Council 0xc2819dc7...), 'sequencer' (EOA 0xdbbe3d8c...), 'router' (L1CrossDomainMessenger, L1StandardBridge), 'bridge' (OptimismPortal2, L1StandardBridge), 'oracle' (Chainlink oracles on World Chain), 'factory' (OptimismMintableERC20Factory), 'token' (WLD, WETH, USDC, WBTC, SDAI), 'multisig' (Alchemy, OpFoundation, Security Council).
All 10 admin addresses and 24+ protocol addresses mapped to ≥1 fetched evidence source (L2BEAT, docs.world.org, Etherscan pages, web search results with Etherscan links).

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice walked official docs (docs.world.org), Etherscan name-tag search results, and L2BEAT's comprehensive permissions matrix. Catalogued 34 addresses: 10 admin/governance multisigs and EOAs (Alchemy 5/8, OpFoundation 5/7, Optimism Security Council 10/13, sequencer EOA, proxy admin), plus 24+ protocol contracts across bridge, portal, messaging, dispute games, system config, and tokens. All addresses trace to fetched evidence sources. No audit links or GitHub repo were available in pinned context.

protocol_metadata.about: World Chain is an Ethereum Layer 2 rollup built on the OP Stack, designed to scale proof-of-personhood via World ID integration. It features priority blockspace for verified humans, reducing bot activity and gas costs. The chain uses OP Stack infrastructure for security (inherits from Ethereum), operates with a permissioned sequencer and Optimism's fault-proof system, and bridges assets (ETH, ERC20, WLD) to and from Ethereum via standardized OP Stack bridge contracts.
